card_name: HDFC Bank Titanium Edge Credit Card
fee_details:
- 1st Year: Rs. 0
- 2nd Year onwards: Rs 1000 (or annual spend of Rs.50,000)
reward_structure:
- Earn Reward Points (RP) on every eligible retail transactions on HDFC Titanium Edge Credit Card for cash back or redeem rewards, movie tickets, or air miles. Also get additional points on dining out.
- Earn 2 RP on every Rs. 100 spend on retail transactions.
- Get additional 50% Reward Points on your dining transactions.
key_highlights:
Earn Rewards Points (RP) on eligible retail transactions on HDFC Titanium Edge Credit Card for cash back or redeem rewards, movie tickets, or air miles. Also get additional points on dining out. The card offers the following benefits:
- Earn 2 RP on every Rs.100 you spend on retail transactions.
- Enjoy additional 50% Reward Points on dining transactions.

benefits_features.Rewards:
Earn 2 RP on every Rs.100 you spend using the card.
Get 25% additional RP on dining spends.
Accumulate Reward Points and redeem for cash back, air miles, and gifts.
Get additional 50% Reward Points on your dining transactions. The additional points are applicable on spends under the Merchant Category Code (MCC) Restaurant and Hotel
benefits_features.Dining:
Get additional 50% Reward Points on your dining transactions.
The additional points are applicable on spends under the Merchant Category Code (MCC) Restaurant and Hotel
benefits_features.Insurance:
Complimentary Accidental Death Insurance cover of up to Rs.50 Lakh.
Complimentary Fire and Burglary cover of up to Rs.2 Lakh on purchases above Rs.5,000.
Applicable on making minimum transactions per month
benefits_features.Fuel:
Get 2% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions Rs.400 and above.
Get up to Rs.2000 in fuel surcharge per month
benefits_features.Zero liability in case of lost card: Call the bank call center around the clock as soon as you discover the loss of your card and you will not be held liable for any fraudulent charges.
benefits_features.Transaction security: The card can be used at both chip enabled and non-chip enabled point of sale/POS terminals to make transactions.
benefits_features.Interest free credit: Get a maximum of 50 interest-free credit days on your purchases from the transaction date

how_tos.How to Apply for HDFC Titanium Edge Cred: You will have to visit your nearest HDFC Bank branch to apply for this credit card. You can locate a branch close to you on the bank’s website. Remember to take all the necessary documents to successfully apply for this card.
how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points Earned on HD:
You can redeem your points offline or online per your convenience. Here is a step-by-step guide on redeeming your Reward Points:
Online - Via NetBanking
- Log onto HDFC Credit Card NetBanking account and enter your username and password.
- Go to the Credit Card option located on the top-right side.
- You have to complete a one-time registration for your credit card by clicking the ‘Register Now’ option. The option can be located at the left-hand side on the navigation bar.
- Enter your 4-digit PIN to complete the registration process.
- Then locate ‘Redeem Reward Points’ on the left-hand side of the navigation bar and click on the ‘Continue’ option which will take you to the Online Redemption portal.
- On the Online Redemption Homepage, click the ‘Redeem Reward Points’ option.
- Select your ‘Reward Points’ for redemption and select from the ‘Item, Category’ to search the catalogue.
- Add the items you wish to redeem to your shopping cart.
- Click on ‘View Shopping Cart’ and then check the box next to the order and then the quantity by using the ‘Edit’ option.
- Read the ‘Terms and Conditions’, and once these boxes have you can submit.
- Click ‘Confirm’ to complete the process. You will get a Redemption Order Number. Save the number in case of any future issues.
Important note: The items you wish to redeem will only be sent to the address displayed on the redemption page. If you need to change the delivery address, then you will need to call HDFC credit card customer care and request for an address change before redeeming your points.
Offline - Via Snail Mail/Post
- Check your credit card statement on the NetBanking portal for your accrued points.
- Choose the rewards you wish to redeem from the catalogue and generate the coupon for the same.
- Send a post with the coupon, the request through the ‘Reward Redemption Form’ available on HDFC website. You will have to download this form from the bank’s site, and then send it to the bank to add more coupons to the form.
Once the bank receives your redemption request, the items will be delivered to your address within 15 business days.

reward_point_benefits:
- Earn 2 Reward Points for every Rs. 50 you spend using your card. You can not earn RP on transactions below this amount and non-retail transactions.
- Convert your points to cash back at the rate of 10 RP = Rs.10 (1:1 ratio).
- You may also redeem your earned points for air miles and gifts from the exclusive rewards catalogue.

miscellaneous:
HDFC Titanium Edge Credit Card Credit Limit
The credit limit that will be issued to you will depend on several factors such as your employment, income, credit score, existing credit obligations, and more. The limit that you are issued might be different from another individual who has applied for the same card.

faqs.1. How long are the Rewards Points valid: Your points will be valid for a period of 2 years from the date they are accumulated. For example, if you earned your points in July 2023 then they will be valid until July 2025.
faqs.2. If I convert my Reward Points to cash: If you have converted your RP to cashback, then it can be offset to reduce your outstanding balance on your card.
faqs.3. Will I earn Reward Points on fuel tra: Yes, you will earn RP on all fuel transactions. You will also get a fuel surcharge waiver of 2% if you spend a minimum of Rs.400 in a transaction.
faqs.4. Will I earn Reward Points on paying m: Yes, you will earn RP on paying your insurance premiums through your Titanium Edge Card. However, the maximum points you can earn per transaction is 2,000 points.
faqs.5. Is there a minimum number of Reward P: Yes, you can only redeem your RP on accumulating at least 2,500 points.
